title: Why read 20 investor letters when AI can think like your favorite investors?
author: Zealousideal_Act3186
selftext:
I've noticed that one of the hardest parts of investing today isn't finding information — it's filtering through the endless amount of information.

There are great discussions happening across investor communities, earnings calls, financial news, research reports, and social media, but keeping track of everything is becoming almost impossible.

I'm creating a small Discord community to track these for you, please note this is a community only for serious investors and who are activly doing company research.  
[https://discord.gg/frhb7H6wd](https://discord.gg/frhb7H6wd)
